title: Who is who in Memories of Childhood
back: Zitkala-Sa and Judewin (Carlisle); Bama, Annan and the elder with the packet (Tamil Nadu).

title: Two childhoods in six beats
back: Bells → warning → shears | walk home → packet → study.

back: Bama laughs at the comic sight. Annan explains: the upper-caste landlord would not eat food a Dalit's hand had touched. Laughter turns to anger.

back: Born without honour, she can win it through progress. Bama studies with all her being, stands first, and many become her friends — resistance through achievement.

title: Bama's title

back: Untouchability denies the simplest equality; both parts of the chapter are autobiography as protest.
